items.headline: No. 3 Miami hangs on to beat Florida State, 43-35 in a double-overtime thriller
items.description: — Darian Mensah threw for 326 yards and three touchdowns, the last of them a 3-yarder to Malachi Toney in the second overtime, and No. 3 Miami held on to beat archrival Florida State 43-35 in a back-and-forth classic on Saturday night.
